children: Ciena expects its revenue compound annual growth rate to be about 30% from 2026 through 2029.

The networking company on Wednesday shared a three-year financial targets and outlook. The targets reflect the company's opportunities and confidence in its ability to execute, Chief Financial Officer Marc Graff said.
It anticipates adjusted gross margin will be 50% and adjusted operating margin will be 32% to 35%. Free cash flow margins are projected to be 20%.
Ciena also said it plans to change to financial reporting segments starting in fiscal 2027.

The new segments, which include optical systems, interconnects, global services and routing and other, align with Ciena's growth markets and allow owners improved insight into financial performance, Graff said.
